review.why: Designs cancel flows, save offers, exit surveys and failed-payment recovery to cut voluntary and involuntary churn.
review.summary: Separates voluntary from involuntary churn, then covers a cancel flow (trigger, survey, reason-matched save offer, confirmation, post-cancel), proactive retention with risk signals and a health score with coverage rules, a dunning stack with retry timing by decline type and emails, plus benchmarks, metrics and test ideas.
strengths: Save offers are matched to the stated cancel reason
No dark patterns: keeps continue-cancelling visible and names click-to-cancel rules
Health score rules treat missing signals as unavailable, not zero
cautions: Benchmarks and thresholds are rules of thumb
Two reference files are not read here
